interest_rate_sensitivity: A hypothetical 100 basis point increase in interest rates would not have a material impact on financial condition or results of operations due to the short-term nature of cash equivalents
debt_interest_rate_type: Senior Notes carry fixed annual interest rates (no economic interest rate exposure on principal, but fair value is interest-rate sensitive); borrowings under the 2024 Credit Agreement bear variable interest rates
foreign_exchange_exposure: Translation exposure from converting foreign subsidiaries' financial statements into USD, plus transaction exposure from remeasuring monetary assets/liabilities denominated in non-functional currencies
foreign_currency_gains_losses: Not material for the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024, and 2023
hedging_policy: Does not currently use derivatives to hedge FX risk, but may do so in the future
